title: Jucy Uruguayan Butter Stew
description: A rich and creamy stew originating from Uruguay, featuring a balance of flavors from dill and butter, perfect for a cold evening meal.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the olive oil and sauté the onion, garlic, potatoes, carrots, and celery until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are cooked through.
Stir in the dill and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Gradually add the milk, stirring constantly to prevent the mixture from breaking.
Increase the heat to medium and cook, stirring frequently, until the stew has thickened and the sauce has reduced slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional dill if desired.
